title: Waiting for the phone and the 1966 heart attack
summary: After three idle years he had a heart attack.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: I don't even think they think, but I have also learned that when I go around looking for things, nothing happens. You like to do that? That's nice, but they never call.
I'm sure that can be infuriating.
It was so bad to the point, I think it gave me a heart attack at one point, and I have stopped thinking about it.
What year did you have a heart attack?

In '66, after not working for about three years. Up until then I could always get away with it, thinking there would be a tomorrow; at one point I realized there won't be a tomorrow, and I think that's what kicked it off.
